text.tspan: Optional
CONFLICT-RESOLUTION PROTOCOL 冲突解决流程
Clarify, test, reconfigure, govern—and preserve legitimate dissent.
澄清、检验证据、调整方案、按规则治理，并保留合理异议
PROTOCOL RECORD 流程记录
Conflict ID 冲突编号
Linked decision / alternative IDs 关联决定或方案编号
Roles involved 涉及角色
Protocol owner / date 流程负责人及日期
CLARIFY 澄清
Clarify the proposition 澄清争议主张
Are all parties disagreeing about the same specific proposition?
各方是否在讨论同一个具体主张？
RECORD 填写记录
Apply safeguards and constraints 应用底线和可行性约束
Does any option violate a safeguard or feasibility limit?
是否有方案违反底线或可行性限制？
RECORD 填写记录
RECONCILE 协调
Review role-specific values 检查不同角色的合理诉求
Which legitimate role priorities drive the disagreement?
哪些合理的角色目标造成了分歧？
RECORD 填写记录
GOVERN 治理
Apply the pre-agreed decision rule 应用事先约定的决策规则
Which pre-agreed decision rule and authority apply?
应使用哪项事先约定的规则和权限？
RECORD 填写记录
Clarified 概念已澄清
Evidence strengthened 证据已加强
Redesigned / escalated 方案已调整或升级
Dissent documented 异议已记录
合理结果不一定是达成共识：也可以是澄清概念、补强证据、调整方案、升级专业判断、按规则决策或记录异议。 A valid outcome need not be consensus.
Inspect the evidence 检查证据
Is the shared evidence relevant and strong enough; what is missing?
共同证据是否相关、充分；还缺什么？
RECORD / 填写记录
Reconfigure the alternatives 调整备选方案
Can options be modified, combined, reduced or staged?
能否修改、组合、缩小范围或分阶段测试？
RECORD 填写记录
Escalate missing expertise 补充缺失的专业判断
What specialist or institutional authority is missing?
当前缺少哪类专家或机构授权？
RECORD 填写记录
Record dissent and revisit conditions 记录异议与重审条件
Who still disagrees, why, and what would reopen the decision?
谁仍不同意、为什么、何时重新讨论？
RECORD 填写记录
TEST BOUNDARIES
检查边界
